narrativeImpact.story: Two months later, you delivered early prototypes for a hard-case travel system built around “protection without fuss”—vanity and tech modules designed to pair with Echelon’s suitcases. Kartik pushed to stay in thin-wall, scuff-resistant strengths, while Andrea argued the hero line needed a clearer promise than “another luggage set.” Earl demanded new-customer pull, not accessories. The team moved forward, but mismatched definitions of the hero product stalled launch planning.

Early prototypes impressed OEM evaluators, and the pipeline signaled scalable growth.
